title: Studying While Raising Children
paragraphs: Determined to finish her degree despite having two young children, Widad enrolled in evening classes that met three times a week after her husband returned home from work.
Balancing coursework, a part-time job, and family responsibilities left her exhausted most nights, and she often studied for exams while sitting on the floor beside her children's beds.
During one particularly difficult semester, she nearly withdrew from the program, but her husband rearranged his own schedule for a month to give her extra study time before her final exams.
Widad graduated two years later than originally planned, but she says the delay taught her something valuable: that meaningful goals rarely follow a perfectly straight or convenient timeline.
